result.title: Evolutionary Adaptive Neighborhood Learning: A Genetic Algorithm for Instance-Dependent k Optimization in Nearest Neighbor Classification
result.summary: The number of neighbours k is the central hyperparameter of the k-nearest neighbour (k-NN) classifier and is usually selected globally through cross-validation or evolutionary search. However, the bias-variance trade-off is inherently local: dense and noise-free regions may favour small neighbourhoods, whereas sparse or noisy regions may require larger ones. Since global-k optimization is one-dimensional, replacing exhaustive search with a genetic algorithm offers little computational advantage. We therefore optimize an instance-dependent neighbourhood policy instead. We propose EANK (Evolutionary Adaptive Neighborhood K), which uses a low-dimensional policy to map local neighbourhood descriptors, including density, label entropy, vote margin, and concentration, to an adaptive number of neighbours k(x). A real-coded elitist genetic algorithm optimizes this policy using leave-one-out accuracy with a neighbourhood-smoothness penalty. Precomputed neighbour votes reduce fitness evaluation costs. We investigate theoretical properties of the method, including dominance over global-k solutions on the training criterion, evolutionary convergence, policy regularity, and generalization guarantees. Experiments on synthetic data with spatially heterogeneous structure and twelve public datasets evaluate predictive performance, robustness, and computational cost. Under nested cross-validation, EANK achieves competitive performance relative to tuned global-k baselines and improves upon the default k=5. We also examine the gap between training and test performance to assess the practical value of adaptive neighbourhood selection.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EANK，用低维策略把局部邻域描述子（密度、标签熵、投票边际、集中度）映射为实例相关的邻居数 k(x)，并以实数编码精英遗传算法在留一准确率加邻域平滑惩罚下优化该策略，附带理论性质与合成数据及十二个公开数据集的实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按局部证据特征逐实例分配计算量」的表述与 LVR 中动态 THINK/LOOK/STOP 预算策略可能相通，用进化搜索优化不可微的实例级控制策略、以平滑惩罚约束策略规律性也可供核查，但该文属经典 k-NN 领域，与视觉 latent 表示无直接联系。
